description: This source file implements variable tracking for TorchScript objects during Dynamo tracing, including classes for handling opaque objects and TorchScript objects with safety features, attribute access, method calls, and integration with Dynamo's tracing system.

classes.name: OpaqueObjectClassVariable
classes.description: Represents an opaque class object, handling attribute access and function calls with safety checks.

classes.name: TorchScriptObjectVariable
classes.description: Represents a TorchScript object with safe attribute access and method call handling, including support for opaque types and integration with Dynamo tracing.

methods.name: _raise_hard_error_if_graph_break
methods.description: Decorator factory that wraps functions to convert Unsupported exceptions into UnsafeScriptObjectError during graph breaks.

methods.name: as_python_constant
methods.description: Returns the constant Python value represented by the variable.

methods.name: is_python_constant
methods.description: Indicates whether the variable is a Python constant.

methods.name: is_python_hashable
methods.description: Checks if the variable is hashable in Python.

methods.name: var_getattr
methods.description: Gets an attribute of the TorchScript object, with safety checks and special handling for opaque types.

methods.name: call_method
methods.description: Calls a method on the TorchScript object, with safety checks and handling for opaque types.

methods.name: as_proxy
methods.description: Returns the proxy object associated with the TorchScript object.
